Bike shops in Seattle: repairs, parts, rentals

Bike shops in Seattle that do repairs. If something breaks in transit or the night before, start here. Call ahead on event weekends. Mechanics get slammed.

For: Seattle to Portland Bicycle Classic.

Bike shops in Seattle: repairs, parts, rentals, listed

  1. Montlake Bicycle Shop

    2223 24th Ave E, Seattle, WA 98112 · (206) 329-7333

    repairrentalparts

    Closest full-service shop to the STP start; rents city, electric and mountain bikes.

  2. R+E Cycles (Rodriguez Bicycle Company)

    5627 University Way NE, Seattle, WA 98105

    repairparts

    Custom hand-built Rodriguez bikes and tandems, plus repairs, at the north end of the Ave.

  3. Gregg's Greenlake Cycle

    7007 Woodlawn Ave NE, Seattle, WA 98115 · (206) 523-1822

    repairparts

    Large shop with service and bike fitting, about two miles north of campus.

  4. Recycled Cycles

    repairrentalparts

    New and used bikes, rentals bookable online, service packages; in Seattle since 1994. Confirm the street address on their site.
